title: Chapter 637
paragraphs: Chapter 637
Episode 163. Return to the Clan (6)
He, too, was clearly a knight made from chaos, a power of the prophet.
However, his appearance was distinct from other knights.
Instead of the dull and dark feeling unique to the spirit of chaos, his body was imbued with a subtle violet light.
His eyes didn't bear any ferocious look like a beast starved for blood. The deep, heavy gaze of a master swordsman at its peak stared at Jin.
He was powerful.
Powerful enough that there was no need to cross swords to confirm it.
Jin carefully scrutinized him while sifting through his memory. A description of a former clan head he had read in the Storm Library came to mind.
The previous clan head of Runekendel, who was called "The Lion King" because of his long hair spread out like the mane of a wild beast.
Lionel Runekendel, that was the name of the man who had come out of the tomb.
"As the last child born of Runekendel, I meet the sixth head of the clan."
Jin greeted Lionel with a calm demeanor.
[Ho, you recognize me. I heard there were hardly any stories left about me. Intriguing.]
The records about him were almost entirely left in the Storm Library.
His era was not long after Runekendel was defeated by Zephl, so most of the records were destroyed.
"You said it's intriguing, so will you accept one question from me?"
[What is it?]
"You, ancestor, appear to have clear reason and will, unlike other chaos. So, you probably don't find the current state of the clan beautiful. For whose punishment did you come back from the dead?"
[Ha ha ha! You seem ready to rush at me if I don't side with you.]
"Please answer."
[I'm just a ghost subject to the summoner. So, my job is to punish you. You're asking the obvious. Well, in my view, the judgment of this girl Rosa is not so bad.]
"Then, I can no longer respect you, Lionel. From now on, please accept the disgrace of being slashed by the sword of your descendants with humility....."
[A very good provocation.]
Jin's eyes filled with blue light sharpened.
At the same time, Lionel slashed the air with the longsword formed from the spirit of chaos.
Swish...!
The stroke lightly swung by Lionel distorted the space, pouring out the sword energy that reached the realm of Sword Wave.
The centripetal and centrifugal forces produced by his sword energy swept away the nearby Knights of Chaos en masse.
Lionel had no interest in their safety.

Except for Thémar, he was filled with the determination to kill here the unmistakable descendant who most resembled Shyron and was definitely rated as the strongest current head of the Runekendel family.
In the time that Lionel's sword energy was striking Jin.
Stem was targeting Jin's rear and was inwardly appalled.
'Even though he completely turned his back... there's no visible opening.'
He couldn't even dare to reach out with his sword against Jin who had his back turned. He was sure that rushing in would only result in a futile attack.
Just a few years ago, the 12th generation of the clan who he had saved was showing the dignity of an absolute master.
And Jin, seemingly unfazed...
...showed the sight of 'tearing apart' Lionel's sword energy. And not with a sword, but with his bare hands.
"I thought you would have given me the upper hand, but this is embarrassing."
Show off.
Jin was looking up at Lionel, who was larger in stature, but Lionel felt as though that gaze had started from an even higher place.
[Although I've lived my entire life in arrogance, I'm not so insensitive as to allow such a thing against you.]
Lionel was not taken aback, even as he saw his sword energy converging into Jin's hand and disappearing.
He recognized it instantly. The fact that Jin was stronger than him.
[The kids should back off. Standing around is as much a threat to that guy as the air.]
Ran, Vyugo, Mu, Ann.
These were the ones Lionel referred to as 'kids.' They had been waiting for an opportunity to attack Jin while controlling the Knights of Chaos.
"We cannot, Lord Lionel. Mother's orders come first."
[Rosa wouldn't have told you to kill that kid. You can't tell the difference between heaven and earth. If you don't value your lives, do as you wish.]
Swoosh-!
Again, Lionel was the first to close the distance. His rushing speed caused the air to burst and shockwaves to occur everywhere, and Jin swung his Bradamante against him.
Lionel was superior in strength. Jin was bounced back the moment their swords clashed, and only then did Stem find an opening to penetrate.
Small cracks ran through Multer's rune and the breastplate of his armor. If they hadn't avoided it, their swords would have pierced the armor and ruptured their necks and hearts.
Although Jin's sword had touched Lionel's chest and Stem's armor, the situation was definitely one where Jin was pushed back.
The three swords clashing several times per second caused a roaring and trembling noise as if a mountain or a castle was collapsing.
The swords of the clan protectors planted in the garden were disappearing due to the effects of the superhumans' battle.
The rusty and shining swords that held history and pride were breaking.
The sight was heartbreakingly painful for only one person in this garden, Jin.
"[You're strong. Incredibly strong! Isn't it possible for you to stand by your mother's side and fight now? With your and Rosa's power, you can easily hold the world in your hands!]
"Lionel, you introduced yourself to me as merely a wraith bound to a summoner."
Jin pushes Stan back and takes Lionel's attack.

"I am the same. I, too, am a human being bound by the values of my clan. No matter how comfortable the path is, no matter how sweet the temptation is. I can't simply ignore those values... Struggle. It's just that dreadful thing."
[How foolish, to say such unnecessary things out of pity. But survival is the foundation of struggle. Your mother is fulfilling it better than anyone else.]
"I admit it. If Rosa Runcandel wasn't from the Runcandel family, but from another family, I would have considered her a great figure."
Phsst!
A pale line of blood spurted from Lionel's right cheek.
He didn't notice the moment Jin's sword passed his face. This was the first time he had ever completely lost track of an opponent's sword in battle.
'If I hadn't reacted unconsciously, it would have been the end.'
But even that didn't surprise Lionel.
It was just another reminder that he was facing an unprecedentedly strong enemy, one he had never met even in life.
Fear and excitement chilled Lionel's back. Stan was also wrapped in a similar sensation.
[Even with the power that would have made you a supreme being in my time, you still hold onto something as boyish as a dream. That will be the reason for your death today.]
Jin didn't answer and swung his sword again.
The pure size of strength was still in favor of Lionel and Stan. The bruises on Muta's rune and armor were also getting faster over time.
Their breathing was getting faster too.
On the other hand, Lionel and Stan's swords were becoming more perfectly synchronized.
When Lionel moved in and created a gap, Stan's sword inevitably pierced and sliced the armor.
Blood flowed from between the helmet.
'As expected, facing two people in this state is too much.'
Just hold on a little longer.
Although he never lost his composure, Jin was clearly being pushed back.
Lionel showed no signs of fatigue despite continuously firing his decisive skills, and Stan controlled the flow of battle as if he had combined the characteristics of Yona and Luna.
He was surprisingly quiet when striking a gap, and oppressively heavy when adding pressure.
That's why Jin found Stan to be a more difficult opponent than Lionel.
'Besides, both of them must have some tricks up their sleeves.'
That was also true for Jin.
However, Jin was constantly aware of a variable that he could absolutely not handle. It would be a waste to use his hidden techniques now.
'The chaotic energy hammering the Karma is gradually fading. If this trend continues, the time I have to hold on without pulling out another card is....'
"About 5 minutes.
If I can withstand that, it should be okay to reclaim the power of Upwha that is protecting the escaping resistors.
That was why Jin had been losing to Lionel and Staem in the power struggle so far.
'It's hard to gauge whether I can withstand their offensive with pure swordsmanship until then...'
At that moment of thought.
Jin could suddenly feel the spiritual connection to Upwha drastically weakening.
From afar, someone's aura began to push the spiritual energy back in full force.
Jordan Runkandel.
He had begun to unleash the power he had accumulated under the protection of Upwha.
Gaaaah...!
Tess, who had been protecting the resistors from the sky, also let out a roar. It was a signal that the resistors were escaping the Sword Garden and heading towards Kalon.
Without knowing, Jin smiled.
'It's done.'
The flames of Upwha that had filled the Sword Garden disappeared all at once.
At the same time, Lionel and Staem kept their distance.
The moment Upwha disappeared, they recognized that Jin's energy had changed.
However, Upwha had not disappeared, but had returned to Jin.
Upwha, returned to Jin, once again dyed him in blue.
Jin's flesh, revealed as Muelta's rune and armor were dismissed, perfectly reproduced the aura of the emperor's Upwha.
'The Upwha he's been using against us was only half...!?'
Both Lionel and Staem.
It was something they had never thought of. They knew that Upwha was protecting the resistors, but they could not imagine that this prevented him from fully manifesting his power.
It's not because they were short-sighted.
No one would have thought that the transcendent fire, which had been pushing away the chaos emitted by the entire Sword Garden, was merely half of its power.
"Lionel, I think I need to tell you one thing before we finish."
Lionel's wide-open eyes were shaking.
He was in awe. As a descendant blessed with witnessing the legend of the Emperor, Sara Runkandel.

"Unlike you, Lady Sara fought for Runkandel for a thousand years even after her death. Even though her body was broken and her inner self was more devastated... she never compromised with anything during that long period."
Can you say that the thousand years of struggle and will she cherished was just a boy's dream?
Lionel couldn't choose an answer to Jin's following words.
"You can't answer. That's why you're meeting death once again here today."
Bradamante was rushing towards Lionel and Staem. Like the blade of a guillotine falling on the traitor.
